message: Goal: small Bluetooth RC car with car-style steering (rear 130 motor via DRV8833, SG90 steering servo), commands 'D,<throttle>,<steer>' from the rc_remote over an HC-05 pair, failsafe stop on silence or link loss, 4xAA with an S7V8F5 buck-boost for the logic and servo, battery report back to the remote; board to hand-solder.
